description: This file defines a utility class 'TableFinder' with a static method 'findTableStartsWith' that searches within a Rom object for a table whose name starts with a specified string. It handles cases where no tables or multiple tables are found by throwing exceptions.

classes.name: TableFinder
classes.description: A utility class for finding specific tables within a Rom object based on name filtering.

methods.name: findTableStartsWith
methods.description: Searches for a single table in the provided Rom object whose name starts with the specified string. Throws exceptions if none or multiple matches are found.
